P.name: Eternal Hunger
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Warwick''' deals {{as|{{pp|6 + (55-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

While {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}}, '''Warwick''' also {{tip|heal|heals}} for 100% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} dealt by ''Eternal Hunger'', increased to 250% while {{as|below 25% '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Jaws of the Beast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' {{tip|lunge|lunges}} at the target enemy over {{rutngt|0.2475}} and bites them, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and most modifiers.}} dealt, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
Q.description2: While ''Jaws of the Beast'' is active, '''Warwick''' is {{tip|displacement immune}} and clamps his jaw on the target, following '''all''' of their movement. The ability can be held for additional effects.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Hold:}} '''Warwick''' performs the bite, and then begins to {{tip|channel|charge}} for {{fd|0.5 seconds}}, extended if the target is under effects of a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|airborne|displacement}}. During the charge, he {{tip|dash|leaps}} behind the target.

W.name: Blood Hunt
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Warwick''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds upon damaging a target to or while they are below {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}}} with a basic attack or {{tip|ability damage}}, refreshing with subsequent damaging basic attacks or ability damage to enemies below the threshold. If '''Warwick''' does not have the {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} already, he also gains it upon initiating an {{tip|attack windup}} against an enemy below the threshold.
W.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Warwick''' senses all enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} on the map who are damaged below {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''maximum''' health}}}} by him or an allied source, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' until they {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerate}}}} or {{tip|heal|heal}} above this threshold again. He sees trails leading toward them and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while following a trail. This bonus is lost for {{fd|0.5}} seconds upon [[Combat status|entering champion combat]], but will build up again over {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
W.description3: The {{as|attack speed|attack speed}} and {{as|movement speed}} bonuses granted by both passives are doubled against enemies who are below {{as|{{sti|health|25% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Increased Attack Speed|{{ap|70*2 to 110*2}}%}}
{{st|Increased Movement Speed|{{ap|35*2 to 65*2}}%}}
W.description4: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' senses the nearest enemy champion in the area at the start of the cast time, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' for 8 seconds, gaining both passive bonuses against them regardless of their {{as|{{sti|health|'''current''' health}}}}.
W.description5: ''Blood Hunt's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 30% if no enemy champions are found within range.

E.name: Primal Howl
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' gains damage reduction for up to {{fd|2.75}} seconds. ''Primal Howl'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Warwick''' howls, ending ''Primal Howl's'' effects and {{tip|fear|fearing}} nearby enemies for 1 second, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 90%.
E.description4: Starting ''{{ais|Infinite Duress|Warwick}}'' channel while ''Primal Howl'' is active will initiate the recast without ending the damage reduction buff prematurely.
E.description5: ''Primal Howl's recast {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Warwick's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Infinite Duress
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Warwick''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}, stopping upon hitting an enemy champion. He then {{tip|knockdown|knocks them down}} and {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds to {{tip|suppression|suppress}}, {{tip|true sight|reveal}}, and deal {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process. This damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
R.description3: '''Warwick''' {{tip|heals}} for 100% of all {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} he deals to the target during ''Infinite Duress''.
R.description4: ''Infinite Duress'' both applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects 3 times over its duration.
R.description5: ''{{ai|Primal Howl|Warwick}} can be cast during the dash.''
